profile.org_note: Single-company structure with two markets: Madison (headquarters) and Milwaukee (run by a VP of Operations). Veridian is one of the companies in Forgewell Building Group, LLC (formed 2023-01-01; also Dave Jones, Auburn Ridge / Marshall Towne Building Supply, Associated Housewrights), chaired by Veridian founder and principal owner David Simon; the exact ownership chain is not public. Land decisions sit with president Chris Ehlers (a former VP of land acquisition and development) and VP of Land Development Matt Brink; finance sits with a small finance team whose head is not confirmed by a company source.
profile.email_pattern: first initial + last name @veridianhomes.com (one published example only)
profile.summary: Conventional for-sale homebuilder and neighborhood developer, family-owned, building only in Wisconsin (Madison area and, since 2014, the Milwaukee area); the Wisconsin DNR page calls it the largest residential builder in Dane County and the company said in 2020 it builds about 600 homes a year. It entitles and develops its own large, multi-phase neighborhoods (Hill Valley 841 homesites, Reiland Grove 561, Midpoint Meadows about 250 lots) and its site lists 25 neighborhoods. Leadership is small: founder David Simon chairs the Forgewell parent group and Chris Ehlers, a land executive by background, has been president since November 2023.

Treasurer / capital markets: not publicly disclosed (private company).
Director of Land Development: the role exists (a Veridian job posting for a Land Development Project Manager refers to it) but the holder is not publicly named.

Director of Land Acquisition, Greater Milwaukee: job-board search snippets show Veridian (via Veridian Management Solutions, LLC) advertising this role; the postings now return 410/404 so they were not opened, and the posting date and whether it was filled are not public.
Head of land acquisition for the Madison market: not publicly named; Chris Ehlers held the VP Land Acquisition and Development role until 2021 and no successor with that title was found.
Madison market / operations leader, COO, construction and purchasing heads: not publicly named since Ehlers moved from COO to president in 2023.

Titles for Scott Blondin (named at the 2026-11-05 Reiland Grove event) and Dave Alberts (company contact on the Wisconsin DNR Green Tier page, 608-209-4960) are not published, so they are not listed as people.

Company history (2003 combination of Don Simon Homes and Midland Builders): seen only in a search snippet of Builder's 2003 coverage; builderonline.com returned 403 so it is not cited. Pro Builder (2007-12) described Veridian as about four years old with David Simon and Jeff Rosenberg (then president of land development and acquisition) as partners; Rosenberg's current involvement is not public.
Builder 100 profile (rank, closings, revenue, CEO label) could not be opened (403); those figures are left to the spine.
No company leadership page exists; the site's team page lists only sales staff. Shared web-search allowance ran out before a last pass on Milwaukee land staff and local-press coverage.
